commands.name: hq
commands.description: Refresh the crew board and show its pane; "show <id>" prints one task, "view" switches Focus and Projects, "go <name>" jumps to a session or task in tmux, "seen" clears JUST FINISHED, "brief" says what changed since you last looked

tools.name: hq_board
tools.description: Read-only. The crew board as JSON: open tasks (id, short name, repo, state, age, note, decision id and question when one is open), live claude sessions (name, project, state, age, tmux target, `link`: the claude.ai URL that opens the session, when it has one), the lead session of each task (`leadGuessed` when it is only a guess by project) and its GitHub PR (number, state) when known, and the best lead per project. Call it before relaying an instruction.

tools.name: hq_answer
tools.description: Records the user's answer to a held crew task or an open decision (runs crew answer). id: a decision id such as D3, or a held task; answer: the user's words verbatim. Returns the lead session to notify.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
